tasks.label: Temiz yeniden derle
tasks.command: rm -rf build && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build --parallel

tasks.label: Release derle ve test et
tasks.command: cmake -B build-rel -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build-rel --parallel && ctest --test-dir build-rel --output-on-failure

tasks.label: Uyari denetimi (sifir uyari bekleniyor)
tasks.command: rm -rf build-warn && cmake -B build-warn -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug > /dev/null && cmake --build build-warn --parallel 2>&1 | grep -i 'Warning:' && echo 'UYARI BULUNDU' || echo 'Uyari yok.'
